additional_sources.label: NCCP NCIS antiemetics v8 · Table 1 and multi-day guidance
Forastiere et al. JCO 1992 · randomised SWOG trial
Chitapanarux et al. EJC 2007 · nasopharyngeal chemoradiation trial
Koyama et al. ESMO Open 2024 · phase II trial
Koyama et al. 2024 corrigendum · paronychia counts

00314: Historical advanced-disease comparison; not evidence of curative benefit or the exact current schedule.
Response, survival and treatment-related harm are different outcomes; cross-trial comparisons do not rank current alternatives.
00552: As-treated analysis, single-centre design and a combined concurrent/adjuvant intervention limit causal attribution to one phase.
No separate absolute survival benefit is assigned to three adjuvant carboplatin/FU cycles.
00417: Not a comparison with modern immunotherapy or proof of benefit for all locally advanced settings.
Do not assign the pooled result separately to cisplatin-only or carboplatin-only patients.
00418: Not a comparison with modern immunotherapy or proof of benefit for all locally advanced settings.
Do not assign the pooled result separately to cisplatin-only or carboplatin-only patients.
00696: Small non-randomised selected cohort; different default paclitaxel dose and prior-therapy requirements.
The corrigendum corrects grade 1/2 paronychia to 12/35 (34%); it does not change efficacy.

source_corrections: 00314 uses split cisplatin 25 mg/m² Days 1–4, q28; the cited Forastiere trial used 100 mg/m² Day 1, q21. No trial median is assigned to the split-dose regimen.

00552 comprises up to three adjuvant nasopharyngeal cycles after 00419 carboplatin/RT, rather than generic metastatic head and neck treatment. The page 2 cross-reference to 00417 conflicts with page 1 and the named drug/radiotherapy regimen.
00417/00418 give weekly cetuximab with q21 chemotherapy and have different daily fluorouracil infusion durations. EXTREME outcomes pool the platinum choices and include cetuximab continuation.

00696 usual paclitaxel 80 mg/m² differs from the Koyama 100 mg/m² study; its post-platinum/post-PD-1 phase II population is narrower than the NCCP indication. The corrigendum changes grade 1/2 paronychia to 12/35.

Cetuximab observation discrepancy: current EMA requires at least one hour after every infusion, whereas NCCP permits cessation after two tolerated doses. The governed observation plan needs reconciliation.

NCIS multiday guidance cannot be replaced by a single-day antiemetic schedule. The four-day cisplatin plan deliberately requires a completed prescription. Combined cetuximab/paclitaxel premedication must not be duplicated.
